questions.prompt: What should students do with the three strengths at the end of the activity?
options: Email them to the safeguarding team
Replace last year's versions in Navigate - they go into live applications this term
questions.explanation: Replace last year's versions. These go into live applications this term.

questions.prompt: Which of these is 'evidence' rather than a claim, according to the deck?
options: 'On placement I fixed a file nobody else could open - then wrote a one-page guide so the next person could do it without me'
questions.explanation: That is specific, checkable, memorable evidence - the level a personal statement or a professional portfolio needs.

questions.prompt: What is the Year 2 reframe of the Skills Assessment?
options: Same as Year 1 - what are my skills?
What moved, and what does that prove? - movement is the story
questions.explanation: Today's question isn't 'what are my skills?' - it's 'what moved, and what does that prove?'

questions.prompt: What is the deck's claim about interview questions?
options: At interview, nearly every question is secretly about one of the human skills (communication, teamwork, reliability, problem-solving, adaptability, initiative)
They are about personality tests only
They are all about technical skill
questions.explanation: At interview, nearly every question is secretly about one of the six human skills.

questions.prompt: What matters most for the reference, according to the deck?

questions.explanation: Recent pattern weighs heaviest - referees write from the freshest evidence.

questions.prompt: Why does the deck say 'this year counts double'?

Because you have double the work
Because there are two of you
questions.explanation: This year counts double because this is the year referees and interviewers are actually watching.

questions.prompt: What is the main difference in Year 2?
options: Evidence is used in real applications

questions.prompt: What is the framing of this Year 2 professional behaviour session?
options: Deployment, not repetition - last year you built the evidence bank; this year you use it
